declarations.name: FormRequiredCheckboxesElement
declarations.description: Web component that enables requirement rules for checkbox groups.

members.name: required
members.description: Authored exact count or ascending range; updates live.

members.name: notice
members.deprecated: Will be removed in a future major release. Use noticeMessage or shared JSON messages.
members.description: Legacy literal notice override, below notice-message in precedence.

members.name: error
members.deprecated: Will be removed in a future major release. Use errorMessage or shared JSON messages.
members.description: Legacy literal error override, below error-message in precedence.

members.name: lang
members.description: Authored language; empty when absent. Inheritance is resolved separately across shadow hosts.

members.name: enhanced
members.description: Whether this instance has a working enhancement; false before setup and after disconnection.

members.name: checkedCount
members.description: Current checked managed controls, including disabled controls; zero when not enhanced.

members.name: valid
members.description: Count-constraint validity, not complete native form validity; null when not enhanced.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Reread configuration and controls without replacing them. Invalid configuration logs an error and retains the last valid enhancement. Disconnected calls return false.

members.name: customTranslations
members.deprecated: Prefer authored instance/shared messages; built-in and registered catalogs remain supported in this release.

members.name: registerTranslations
members.description: Validate and merge partial catalogs per language/key. Existing instances reread them on refresh; invalid catalogs throw without replacing previous values.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The number (or range) of required checkboxes.

attributes.name: notice
attributes.deprecated: Will be removed in a future major release. Use notice-message or shared JSON messages.
attributes.description: The notice message describing the requirement.

attributes.name: error
attributes.deprecated: Will be removed in a future major release. Use error-message or shared JSON messages.
attributes.description: The error message to show when the requirement is not met.

attributes.name: notice-message
attributes.description: Authored whole-phrase notice template; instance overrides shared per-rule templates and legacy catalogs.

events.name: form-required-checkboxes:change
events.description: Bubbling, composed, noncancelable; frozen detail {checkedCount, minimum, maximum, valid, source: change|reset|refresh}. Emitted after a changed outcome from checkbox change, successful reset, or explicit refresh; not initial setup, setters, equivalent state, or canceled resets.

declarations.name: defineFormRequiredCheckboxes
declarations.description: Guarded automatic registration on import; returns false when no browser registry is available.
